provenance: Reconstructed: InstrumentationResult as DiSLInstrumentor.generateInstrumentation() builds it; trace/identifier paths taken from the generated Collector.java.
notes: resultsListPath is null: DiSLInstrumentor generates a random name (results/generated-tests-<timestamp>-<uuid8>.lst) that is never written to disk, so it is not recoverable.
libs/instrumentation.jar is the stub jar DiSLCompiler writes when DiSL dependencies are missing (manifest Test-Stub: true).
